author: Codex assistant; offline source-based revision after v1 development-error review
instructions: Describe only facts visible in the four ordered source samples; do not invent identities, weather, lights, motives or atmosphere.
Prioritize objects, image position, relative size, orientation, visible body parts and partial occlusion.
Separate camera motion from object motion; specify early versus late changes only where samples establish them.
Describe visible softness or motion smearing without inventing cinematic blur or a different visual style.
Use self-contained English captions of at most six sentences and 80 words; factual completeness takes priority over brevity.
Do not infer inter-sample events or definite motion from a single repeated source sample.
sampling: Same four PLLaVA source indices per frozen segment; no new keyframes or additional temporal samples.
